decisions.reason: As a young automation add-on close to the firm's digital control trajectory, its uncertainty is still unresolved and its continuation cost is likely moderate relative to its option value.
A web-based dimensioning tool is cheap to keep available and useful for planners and customer acquisition, so the firm is likely to preserve this low-cost option.
This system offering is somewhat costlier and partly overlaps with product A, but it is still early, strategically adjacent, and likely worth retaining until market potential becomes clearer.
